## Summary
China Dragon Technology Limited is an IEEE MA-L registrant in Shenzhen, Guangdong, China; the registry carries the name in two capitalisations with two renderings of the same address, "B4 Bldg. Haoshan 1st Industry Park" (518104) and "B4 Building, No.3 First Industrial Zone, Nanpu Road, Lao Community, Xinqian Street, Baoan District" (518100) [2][3]. It holds 34 MA-L blocks, about 570 million addresses, the first registered 17 November 2015 and the most recent updated 7 October 2026 [1], among them 00:7E:56, 04:39:26, 0C:CD:D0, 1C:79:2D, 24:B7:2A, 3C:3B:AD, 3C:7A:AA, 54:AE:BC, 6C:05:D3, 78:8A:86, A0:9D:C1, A4:6B:40, A8:A0:92, C8:26:E2 and E0:51:D8 [1][3]. A block count that size, still growing in 2026, is the registration pattern of a high-volume electronics manufacturer or module maker rather than a single brand, but that is an inference from the registry alone. No public documentation found for what the company makes: it has no page in DeviWiki [4] or the OpenWrt hardware wiki [5], no company website was located, and the FCC ID mirrors (fccid.io, fcc.report) refused the fetch, so product class, radios, chipsets, FCC grantee code and parent company are all left unknown rather than guessed. An operator seeing one of these OUIs knows only that the hardware was made by a Shenzhen volume manufacturer; the device's own traffic (DHCP hostname, mDNS, SNI) is the next identification step.
